decisions.reason: As a security add-on close to the firm’s core business, it is likely to be retained because prior development effort can be justified as part of a broader secure-communications offering, even though its lower website visibility makes it somewhat easier to discontinue than the more prominently presented products.

Its dedicated webpage in 2019 suggests a visible strategic commitment and substantial investment, which under escalation of commitment makes management likely to continue backing it and interpret any weak traction as temporary.

The firm has publicly committed to this product with a dedicated page and likely sunk development costs, so management would tend to keep it despite the extra burden of a hardware-related offer, hoping adoption still improves.

Because a payment-security compliance suite fits a mature German B2B software firm’s security and enterprise orientation, management is likely to view slower results as normal long sales-cycle effects and keep the product on the market.
